title: Grade 3 4.01
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 3: Identify halves | Recognise one-half | Recognise one-quarter | Recognise one-third | Understand equal parts | Understand fractions of a whole | Identify quarters | Identify thirds | Apply fractions | Use fraction language | Connect symbols and words

questions.question: A shape divided into 2 equal parts has halves. How many halves are there?
questions.solution: Count each object once, then match that total to the choices. The total count is 2.
